items.text: Cardinals placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on IR with high-ankle sprain (new injury, unrelated to prior); out 4-5 weeks, eligible Week 13+.
items.why: High ankle sprain suffered Week 8 vs DAL after prior ankle issues.
items.implication: Love fantasy value frozen; Allgeier (and Knight if cleared) take lead role.
items.opportunity: Tyler Allgeier elevated to RB1/2 usage with goal-line/scrimmage work (191 yds/2 TD in relief).

items.text: Tyler Huntley suffered season-ending (or extended) turf toe injury in relief of Lamar; Joe Fagnano next up and expected to start vs JAX on TNF, though spotted in ankle brace.
items.implication: Ravens QB room depleted; streaming/Fagnano low-upside options only.
items.opportunity: Potential trade for QB before deadline; Flowers/Henry usage shifts under new QB.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and will be placed on injured reserve after injuring it on the first snap of his return vs Bills; earliest return Week 14 post-bye, potentially season-ending.
items.why: Thumb injury requiring surgery on first snap back from ankle sprain.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade for BAL; Zay Flowers to mid-WR2 ROS; Fagnano likely starts TNF.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for remaining skill players if offense stabilizes, but short-term chaos.

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten (JAX RB) ankle/foot: DNP Mon-Tue-Wed, listed Questionable for TNF vs BAL.
items.implication: Monitor for active; backup elevation if OUT.
items.opportunity: Potential full snaps for JAC RBs if inactive.

items.text: Berry Sit/Start + Mailbag reacts to Jeremiyah Love IR; keep-open/close decisions for tough Week 9 starts amid latest news.
items.implication: Pivot to Allgeier or other ARI backs; free roster spot.

items.text: A.J. Brown misses another game due to lingering knee/ankle; limited then DNP prior week, Vrabel 'we'll see' on practice this week.
items.implication: NE WR depth thin; Douglas/Williams/Chism upside in short term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Week 9 flags: BAL loses Lamar likely season; AJ Brown misses another; IND wheels fall off, Jonathan Taylor saga continues. Levitan/Silva cover team-by-team.
items.implication: Avoid or pivot from affected stacks; monitor JT role/trade rumors.
items.opportunity: Waiver targets in LV (Washington/Jeanty context) and other backups.

items.text: Week 9 Waiver: Mike Washington Jr. workhorse edge over Jeanty noteworthy (sticky?); also Antonio Williams ascension, Terrance Ferguson return.
items.implication: Add Washington as Jeanty handcuff/lead candidate; FAAB priority.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, potential goal-line if role sticks.

items.text: Mike Washington Jr. handed LV workhorse role Week 8 with 25-2 carry edge over Ashton Jeanty (Jeanty still elite in pass game/protection); Kubiak calls workload 'moving target' week-to-week.
items.why: Game script and performance; Jeanty 2 carries/9 yds + 3/64 rec.
items.implication: Jeanty downgraded to pass-catching specialist/flex; Washington waiver priority as potential lead.
items.opportunity: Washington snaps/carries/red-zone expansion if sticky; Jeanty still high target share.
items.conflict: Coach says need both; not permanent demotion.

items.text: Lamar absence biggest hit to Zay Flowers fantasy value; falls to mid-range WR2 ROS with backup QB.
items.why: QB downgrade from Lamar to Fagnano/Huntley-less.
items.implication: Temper expectations; still startable but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Target share remains high but efficiency/pace drop likely.

items.text: Sam Darnold (SEA) ruled out with quad/rib; Drew Lock likely starts.
items.implication: SEA pass game volatility; JSN/WRs under Lock.
items.opportunity: Possible run-heavier script benefiting SEA RBs.

items.text: Wheels completely fall off for IND; Jonathan Taylor saga continues amid team dysfunction.
items.implication: JT trade/value volatility; monitor practice/role comments.
items.opportunity: Potential increased or decreased share depending on resolution.

items.text: MNF Recap + Week 9 Waiver Wire podcast: top adds at RB/WR/QB/TE; breakdown SEA backfield outlook post-MNF.
items.why: Post-Week 8 injuries and roles (Lamar, Love, LV RBs, SEA).
items.opportunity: SEA committee, LV Washington, other handcuffs/streamers.

items.text: First full game without Terry McLaurin (IR knee): rookie Antonio Williams led WAS in routes (88%), targets (24%), catches.
items.why: McLaurin IR absence creates clear path.
items.implication: Williams as viable WR3/flex with elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: 88% routes, high target share sticky potential.
